negative_findings.description: No Ukraine-specific press release or customer-reference page was found on the newsrooms of the two dominant ATM OEMs (NCR Atleos, Diebold Nixdorf) naming a Ukrainian bank deployment.
negative_findings.result_summary: English searches returned only global product/strategy news and Russia-exit coverage; no UA deal announcement surfaced in the first pages of results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ATM/recycler supply into Ukraine is a core question for this cell; if OEMs do not announce locally, the deal record must be reconstructed from local partners, bank fleet pages and service tenders instead.

negative_findings.description: No official OEM partner/distributor locator for Ukraine was found for Ingenico, PAX or Verifone.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ukrainian-language search surfaced only self-declared reseller claims (GeneralPay) and bank help pages listing models; no authoritative OEM partner list for UA.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without an OEM-authoritative list, the local partner field must be assembled bottom-up from self-claims, which are weaker evidence and need triangulation.

negative_findings.description: 'Printec' resolves to at least two unrelated Ukrainian entities: printec.com.ua (banking/self-service technology) and printec.ua (retail/office equipment shop).
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results mixed the two domains under one brand name.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated crawling keyed on the brand name will contaminate the dataset; the collector must pin the domain, not the name.

negative_findings.description: Ukrainian terminology for cash-recycling ATMs is unstable — 'банкомат з рециркуляцією', 'ресайклер', 'ресайклінговий банкомат', 'депозитний модуль' all appear; the seed query using 'рециркуляція' returned no vendor press releases.
negative_findings.result_summary: No usable hits for the recycling-ATM seed query in uk.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Query design for this subtopic needs the full alias set plus English-in-Ukrainian forms, otherwise recycler deployments will be systematically missed.

negative_findings.description: SI BIS corporate domain was not directly confirmed in results; only third-party profiles (crm.ua/sibis, compu.fandom.com) were seen.
negative_findings.result_summary: sibis.com.ua is a plausible but unconfirmed canonical host.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The URL must be resolved by the deterministic verification pass before it enters the collection set.

coverage_gaps.description: Card-personalisation, cash-in-transit and ATM outsourcing/servicing providers in Ukraine (e.g. cash-management operators, card bureaux) were not enumerated in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated uk pass on 'персоналізація платіжних карток', 'інкасація', 'аутсорсинг банкоматної мережі', 'обслуговування банкоматів тендер'.

coverage_gaps.description: Ukrainian integrators announce wins on Facebook and LinkedIn faster and more explicitly than on their own websites, but social channels were not systematically enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a social-handle register for every company in the SI Ukraine ranking and monitor posts for 'реалізували проєкт для', 'уклали договір', 'наш клієнт'.

coverage_gaps.description: International core/card-platform vendors present in Ukraine (Temenos, BPC/SmartVista, OpenWay Way4, Finastra, FIS, Euronet, ACI, Compass Plus) were not individually checked for Ukraine-tagged newsroom items.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run one newsroom+site-search pass per vendor with 'Ukraine' and top-20 Ukrainian bank names.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor conference/exhibition materials (e.g. Ukrainian banking-IT forums, NBU-adjacent fintech events) that list sponsors and case-study presentations were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Identify recurring UA banking/payments events and harvest sponsor lists and agendas as an actor pointer.

coverage_gaps.description: Wartime effects — relocation, damaged-branch rebuild programmes, donor-funded equipment supply — were not probed as a driver of vendor announcements since 2022.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a uk pass on 'відновлення відділень', 'донорське фінансування обладнання банк', 'релокація ІТ інфраструктури банку'.

brief: Ukraine's supply-side disclosure landscape for banking/payments technology is dominated by a small, stable set of domestic vendors and integrators — CS Ltd (АБС Б2), UNITY-BARS, ProFIX, Servus Systems Integration, IT-Integrator, SI BIS, the BMS group — most of which publish product, client and news pages in Ukrainian that name bank customers directly, including private-bank deals that never appear in ProZorro. The single richest pointer is the annual «Мережі та Бізнес» SI Ukraine integrator ranking, which enumerates the bidder universe and can be snowballed into a vendor press-room crawler; trade outlets psm7.com and finclub.net act as a catch-net that dates announcements. International OEMs are the weak link: neither the ATM majors nor the POS terminal makers publish Ukraine-specific deal news or an authoritative local partner list, so hardware attribution has to be reconstructed indirectly from acquirer help-centre pages that list exact terminal models and from bank self-service fleet pages. Highest-value next steps are enumerating vendor social channels (where wins are announced first), the ATM servicing/cash-management outsourcing tier, and per-vendor newsroom sweeps of the international core and card platforms.
